content.comment_body: Hello, I am wondering if it's possible to display a DWord value, for example VD 100 obtained via Modbus, on a [product_name] operator device. For instance, with VD 100 = 974389, I need to show it as 97.4%. Thank you in advance. Apologies, I'm not sure how to start a new post.

Welcome to the forum. If the DWord format is Double Integer, unfortunately [product_name] cannot handle calculations using Double Integer—only Integer is supported. If the value is in Float format, the Float/Integer converter allows for a maximum resolution of 0.001, not 0.0001. To create a new topic, look for the 'New Topic' button in each category.

If your program on [product_name] has sufficient resources, you could use a workaround: arranging the bits through logic inputs and outputs to divide the number by powers of two (2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.), achieving a maximum value of 32767 for 100%. Afterward, scale the result using arithmetic functions to show percentages as desired. If you’re interested in an example, let us know your maximum required value, e.g., 100.0%. Regards, [user_name]. There’s an example attached that demonstrates possible solutions.
Here’s a solution for your issue. While [user_name]'s approach is more elegant, this method should also work.
Thank you all for your quick responses. I will try out your suggestions and update you on the results. Best regards, [user_name]
I wanted to add that both solutions worked perfectly. Thanks to your advice, I learned several useful [product_name] techniques. Thanks again, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for ways to show a DWord value, received via Modbus, as a percentage with one decimal on a [product_name] operator device linked to a [product_name] controller. Difficulties arise because [product_name] does not support calculations with Double Integer values and has limitations when converting between numeric formats and scaling. Participants discuss constraints and alternative approaches for achieving the desired functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] operator device to be capable of displaying DWord numerical values as percentage values with decimal places, regardless of the original data format.
